name: vscode-graphqlsp
description: GraphQL syntax highlighting and schema-aware TypeScript support — diagnostics, auto-complete, hover information, and go-to-definition for GraphQL documents — powered by GraphQLSP.
author: 0no.co <hi@0no.co>

untrustedWorkspaces.description: GraphQLSP runs as a TypeScript server plugin, which is disabled in untrusted workspaces.

graphqlsp.schema.markdownDescription:
Path to a `.graphql` SDL file, an introspection JSON file, or the URL of a GraphQL API to introspect. May also be an object of the shape `{ "url": "...", "headers": { ... } }`.

Projects that list `@0no-co/graphqlsp` (or `gql.tada/ts-plugin`) under `compilerOptions.plugins` in their `tsconfig.json` are configured from there instead, and these editor settings don't apply to them.

graphqlsp.schemas.markdownDescription: Multi-schema configuration; an array of `{ "name": "...", "schema": "...", "tadaOutputLocation": "..." }` objects. Mutually exclusive with `#graphqlsp.schema#`.

graphqlsp.template.markdownDescription: An additional template tag or function name to detect GraphQL documents by, in addition to the defaults (`gql` and `graphql`).

graphqlsp.templateIsCallExpression.markdownDescription: When `true`, GraphQL documents are detected in `graphql('...')` call expressions (the gql.tada style); when `false`, in tagged template literals. Defaults to `true`.

graphqlsp.shouldCheckForColocatedFragmen.markdownDescription: When enabled, GraphQLSP checks whether fragments exported from imported files are used in the current document.

graphqlsp.trackFieldUsage.markdownDescription: When enabled, GraphQLSP warns about queried fields that are never used in the surrounding code.

graphqlsp.clientDirectives.markdownDescription: Additional client-side directive names that shouldn't be validated against the schema.

graphqlsp.tadaOutputLocation.markdownDescription: Location (file or directory) that the gql.tada introspection output is written to.

graphqlsp.tadaDisablePreprocessing.markdownDescription: Disables preprocessing of the gql.tada introspection output.
